scope: Diagnostic of one pinned rotated Split fixture, not a native parity or general coverage proof
method: Round result coordinates to Float32; sum three-dimensional triangle areas, count undirected exact-coordinate edge incidences, and sum pairwise triangle intersection areas after projection onto the source face's dominant coordinate plane. The projected intersection sum may contain floating-point noise.
limitations: The tiny nonzero projected overlap may reflect numerical clipping error; no exact-overlap claim is made.
Edge incidence at rounded coordinates does not establish manifoldness or seam topology in general.
The candidate differs from the native facet set and is not adopted in the application.
